description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class `AbstractLogger` in the `Psr\Log` namespace, providing default implementations for various log-level-specific methods that delegate to a generic `log` method. It serves as a base class for creating loggers by extending and implementing the necessary methods.

classes.name: AbstractLogger
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing the LoggerInterface, providing default method implementations for various log levels.

methods.name: emergency
methods.description: Logs a message at the emergency level by delegating to the `log` method with `LogLevel::EMERGENCY`.
